description: Editable native instruments. Revision 4 adds per-layer envelopes, filters and pan plus contrasting dark club bass/lead archetypes. Each preset remains agent-editable; no style is inferred during rendering.

sources.description: Clean fundamental with no intentional upper harmonics.
Bright harmonic source with PolyBLEP edge correction.
Odd harmonic source; pulse width changes its balance and tone.
Band-limited formant-like harmonic wavetable with pitch-selected mip levels; synthetic, not a recorded choir.
Band-limited bright harmonic wavetable with pitch-selected mip levels; synthetic, not a sampled brass instrument.
True two-operator phase modulation with per-layer ratio, index amount and index decay; significant sidebands bounded against Nyquist.
Deterministic, bipolar, zero-mean white noise; revision 2 repairs the formerly biased low-amplitude generator.
CC0 piano multisample with two velocity layers and eight note zones.
CC0 flute multisample with ten note zones; sustained line and counter-melody use.
CC0 nylon guitar with ten note zones and three velocity-selected playing colors: fingerstyle, light pick, firm pick.

sampled_instruments.character: warm upright piano; sampled attacks and natural decay
sampled_instruments.steering: Use as a hook, chord arpeggio, or breakdown foreground.

sampled_instruments.character: breathy sustained wind with recorded vibrato
sampled_instruments.steering: Use for a countermelody or a phrase answer; leave space around held notes.

sampled_instruments.source: Meta Nylon Guitar CC0 OGG previews
sampled_instruments.character: intimate plucked attacks with fingerstyle and two picked dynamics
sampled_instruments.steering: Use for broken chords, rhythmic ostinatos, and contrasting breakdown motifs.

sampled_instruments.character: bright, detailed steel-string pluck with distinct sampled attacks and dynamic layers
sampled_instruments.steering: Use for a short rhythmic pulse or sparse answering motif; filter and saturate for a darker electronic role, and keep away from the sub/bass register.

filter_modes.description: Keeps fundamentals and low harmonics; darkens the source above cutoff.
Removes low frequencies; useful for bright layers and transition noise.
Keeps a band around cutoff; resonance emphasizes a moving spectral focus.
Rejects a band around cutoff while retaining low and high content.
Changes phase around cutoff without selecting a frequency band; useful for phase color.

patch_controls.layer_budget: 1-8 layers, maximum 32 unison voices total per track

lfo.depth: 0..4 octaves for cutoff; amplitude depth clamps to 0..1

effect_controls.description: Per-hit sample start, end length, transient emphasis, and short noise layer. Drum MIDI patterns give each hit an independent position and velocity.
Gain-compensated saturation; soft_clip uses antiderivative antialiasing. Hard/foldback are deliberate unfiltered distortion colors.
Echo time can be free or tempo-synced; feedback and wet are independently adjustable.
Shared, damped diffuse stereo room with MCP-editable decay, pre-delay, filters and return gain.
Modulated short delay creates stereo motion; rate and depth can be changed independently.
Stereo-linked RMS detection with soft knee, explicit makeup and detector highpass.
Actual audio-triggered ducking from a named source track; no phantom pumping during kick-free passages.
Up to 12 independent bands per track, bus or master. Double precision RBJ coefficients; linked band detector for dynamic bell cuts.

presets.name: Clean Sine Sub
presets.description: A centered fundamental-only sub at the requested MIDI pitch. Revision 2 removes the former hidden extra octave drop.
presets.use: Long or short root notes; keep it mono-compatible and let the kick own the transient.

presets.name: Rolling Pulse Bass
presets.description: A firm saw body with a restrained sub octave and a quick filter movement.
presets.use: Sixteenth or eighth-note groove; shorten release when notes crowd the kick.

presets.name: Hollow Pipe Bass
presets.description: A rounded triangle tone with a small nasal upper harmonic layer.
presets.use: Sparse offbeat answers and short accents; avoid doubling every sub note.

presets.name: Brass Cadence Accent
presets.description: A bright brass-like synthetic accent with a falling filter envelope.
presets.use: Cadence hits and fills, with velocity variation and gaps between phrases.

presets.name: FM Bass Edge
presets.description: A sine fundamental with inharmonic FM bite and a controlled upper layer.
presets.use: Use in short phrases or as a transient character layer above a sub.

presets.name: Analog Chord Stab
presets.description: A short, harmonically rich saw chord with a filter snap and measured width from unison.
presets.use: Syncopated chord hits; choose inversions to keep each voice moving smoothly.

presets.name: Open Minor Chord Bed
presets.description: A mellow two-layer chord body designed to leave space for a lead.
presets.use: Sustain through breakdowns; reduce reverb or remove upper chord tones in dense drops.

presets.name: Mono Anthem Lead
presets.description: A focused saw lead with a soft sine body and a restrained cutoff LFO.
presets.use: Main motif; keep one central layer prominent and let delay create the tail.

presets.name: Formant Vocal Lead
presets.description: A synthetic choir spectrum layered with a vowel-like brass formant color; not a vocal recording.
presets.use: Emotional hook phrases; reduce chord density around its held notes.

presets.name: Bright Supersaw
presets.description: A dense, wide-feeling saw stack with a narrow center layer and modest detune.
presets.use: Peak phrases only; lower the layer gain or unison if it masks the vocal or piano hook.

presets.name: Glass FM Bell
presets.description: A bright, inharmonic sine-FM strike with a long decaying tail.
presets.use: Sparse motif punctuation, phrase endings, and high-register answers.

presets.name: Muted Pluck Ostinato
presets.description: A fast-decay pulse and saw combination for a precise repeating figure.
presets.use: Short rhythmic figures; automate delay send at phrase ends instead of leaving every repeat wet.

presets.name: Clockwork Arpeggio
presets.description: A clean square-driven pulse with a small sine fundamental, optimized for repeated notes.
presets.use: Use rests and octave changes to make motion; avoid filling every sixteenth note.

presets.name: Slow String Synth
presets.description: A slow-attack saw/triangle blend with restrained unison for an emotional sustained bed.
presets.use: Breakdowns and theme support; high-pass or lower the gain when the bass returns.

presets.name: Choir Shimmer
presets.description: A synthetic formant bed with a quiet octave shimmer and long release.
presets.use: Use as a background color under a clear lead; automate it out before dense transitions.

presets.name: Organ Pulse
presets.description: A stable triangle and square blend with little detune, giving chords a defined attack.
presets.use: Repeated chord rhythm and harmonic support; shorten gates to keep the groove articulate.

presets.name: Dark Resonant Drone
presets.description: A low saw source under a resonant band-pass with slow cutoff modulation.
presets.use: Long transitions or breakdown tension; keep it quiet and remove low frequencies in the mix.

presets.name: Filtered Noise Lift
presets.description: A noise source with an upward filter envelope; shape it with automation and a short final fade.
presets.use: Builds and transitions only; mute it after the impact so the drop has contrast.

presets.name: Voidglass Formant Lead
presets.description: A dark, moving lead that combines hollow choir formants, a metallic FM overtone, and a low saw body. Its slow band-pass motion keeps sustained notes evolving.
presets.use: Use for the main emotional hook; give it long notes and leave chord stabs out of its register.

presets.name: Shattered Glass FM Hook
presets.description: A brittle, inharmonic FM voice with a soft triangle center and long release; designed for sparse answers and phrase endings.
presets.use: Use as a secondary hook or occasional high answer, not as a constant fast arp.

presets.name: Blackened Reese Motor
presets.description: A textured mid-bass with a narrow detuned saw pair, sine foundation, and slow resonant filter drift. The sub layer stays distinct and centered in the mix.
presets.use: Use for syncopated mid-bass movement above a separate sine sub; sidechain and high-pass it.

presets.name: Granite Impact Bass
presets.description: A compact, distorted brass/FM accent with a hard transient and a clipped spectral tail; deliberately unlike the sustained Reese layer.
presets.use: Place sparsely at phrase ends and drop accents, leaving the main bass rhythm clear.

presets.name: Rusted Orbit Pulse
presets.description: A hollow, metallic pulse with a pulse-width square, FM upper partial, and band-pass resonance. It has a clear attack but a rounded tail.
presets.use: Use selective eighth-note or quarter-note figures with rests; let delay answer the phrase.

presets.name: Cathedral Static Bed
presets.description: A wide-feeling, slowly breathing pad with choir formants, bowed-saw body, and a grain of filtered noise for dark air.
presets.use: Hold through the breakdown; automate its level and filter into the return instead of leaving it full-time.

presets.name: Piston — tuned kick body
presets.description: Phase-reset sine with a fast downward pitch envelope; the kick fundamental is explicit and editable.
presets.use: Four quarter-note hits. Layer one quiet high-passed click on its own track.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Needle — kick attack
presets.description: A short, band-limited noise transient with no low-frequency body.
presets.use: Separate kick transient channel; keep at least 15 dB below kick body.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Foundation — audible sub
presets.description: One sine at the requested pitch. No undocumented octave drop and no extra detuned sub.
presets.use: Centered low end. Confirm fundamental is above 30 Hz; sidechain from actual kick audio.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Torque — narrow PWM mid-bass
presets.description: Two subtly detuned pulse voices with slow pulse-width modulation and a separately filtered triangle body.
presets.use: Rhythmic low-mid movement above the separate sub. Use rests and occasional fifth answers.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Friction — animated FM accent
presets.description: True two-operator phase modulation, ratio 1.5, with a decaying modulation index. It changes from a rough transient into a rounder tail.
presets.use: Interlocking low-mid accents on a separate channel, not every bass hit.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Ceramic — tuned tom
presets.description: A decaying sine/triangle membrane with a modest pitch fall; different from the FM metal layer.
presets.use: Sparse off-grid percussion answers, using pitches in the bass key.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Foundry — inharmonic metal
presets.description: Inharmonic FM ratio 2.414 with a fast index decay, filtered to leave room for the hats.
presets.use: A few quieter syncopated hits; use delay and pan on its own mixer track.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Brushed — noise shaker
presets.description: Proper bipolar noise through a high-pass voice filter, with a short shaped tail.
presets.use: Quiet alternating sixteenth accents, preferably not the same positions as the closed hat.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Lacquer — dark harmonic stab
presets.description: A restrained analog saw/triangle dyad voice with a fast filter envelope and short release.
presets.use: One or two notes per hit. Put sustained harmonic support on a different track.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Hollow — resonant pulse
presets.description: A narrow variable pulse with a resonant bandpass and a small triangle reinforcement.
presets.use: Alternate with the harmonic stab instead of playing both continuously.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Burnished — restrained lead
presets.description: Warm continuous unison with a triangular upper body. No static metallic FM shimmer; motion comes from a slow filter LFO and true oscillator spread.
presets.use: A short recognizable hook, entering after the groove is established. Keep below drum/bass bus.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Silk — wide sustained support
presets.description: Three gently detuned triangle voices with a quiet saw core, slow amplitude envelope and no amplitude tremolo.
presets.use: Sustained single notes or fifths. High-pass the support and leave the lead center clear.

calibration.probe: Two-bar MIDI phrase at 48 kHz; active-window RMS; pre-master

presets.name: Blackroom — sustained analog Reese
presets.description: A centered, low-passed analog saw bass with a restrained sine foundation and triangle body. No FM, metallic resonator, pulse animation, or pluck envelope. Built to hold the groove beneath a four-on-the-floor kick.
presets.use: Default mid-bass for club_drive. Use a root/fifth 8th-note pattern with contiguous 0.50-beat gates; keep sub on its own centered track.

presets.name: Blackroom — dark sustained lead
presets.description: A restrained analog saw/triangle lead with slow onset, moderate sustain and only gentle filter motion. Avoids choir/formant and inharmonic FM timbres that can read as arcade or game scoring.
presets.use: Short 1–2 bar motifs with phrase rests. Use long enough gates to let the tone bloom; keep it behind the kick and bass.

presets.name: Blackroom — pressure Reese
presets.description: A dark, persistent club bass with separate saw body, sine foundation and filtered triangle edge. Each layer has its own envelope, cutoff and pan. Avoids FM, metallic resonators and arcade-style pitch sweeps.
presets.use: Alternative club_drive bass. Sustained root/fifth motion; sidechain to kick. Layers have separate roles and remain mono-compatible at low frequencies.

presets.name: Blackroom — noir lead
presets.description: A compact subtractive techno lead: a driven saw body with a restrained square harmonic layer, shaped for short, connected riffs rather than bell-like tails.
presets.use: Use for evolving, syncopated phrases. Keep the riff articulated; lengthen the envelope only when the arrangement calls for a held note.
